articles.summary: The Jets are trading for the Raiders' Geno Smith, reuniting the quarterback with the team that drafted him in 2013, sources told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Tuesday.

articles.title: Eagles strike, add CB Woolen on one-year deal
articles.summary: Free agent cornerback Riq Woolen reached agreement Tuesday on a one-year deal worth up to $15 million with the Eagles, agent Jason Chayut told ESPN.

articles.title: Sources: Steelers keep Heyward on 1-year deal
articles.summary: The Steelers and longtime defensive captain Cameron Heyward agreed to a one-year extension, Heyward's agent told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Sources: Pats land Packers' Doubs on 4-year deal
articles.summary: The Patriots have agreed to sign former Packers wide receiver Romeo Doubs to a four-year deal worth up to $80 million, sources told ESPN.

articles.title: Sources: Saints, LB Elliss reunite on 3-year deal
articles.summary: The Saints have agreed to a three-year, $33 million deal with linebacker Kaden Elliss, according to NFL Network. Originally drafted by New Orleans, Elliss has spent the past three seasons with the Falcons.

articles.title: Source: Ricard latest to rejoin Harbaugh in N.Y.
articles.summary: Former Ravens fullback Patrick Ricard agreed to a two-year deal with the Giants, a source told ESPN.

articles.summary: Offensive lineman Elgton Jenkins is signing a two-year deal with the Browns one day after he was released by the Packers, a source told ESPN's Adam Schefter on Tuesday.

articles.title: Snell, FB who helped Jets win SB III, dies at 84
articles.summary: Matt Snell, a three-time Pro Bowl fullback who scored the only touchdown in the Jets' upset of the Colts in Super Bowl III, died of natural causes Tuesday at age 84.

articles.title: Texans bolster O-line, reach deal with OT Smith
articles.summary: Free agent offensive tackle Braden Smith reached agreement with the Houston Texans on a two-year, $25 million contract that includes $13.5 million fully guaranteed, his agent told ESPN's Adam Schefter.

articles.title: Sources: TE Knox stays with Bills on new deal
articles.summary: The Bills found a way to keep tight end Dawson Knox on the 2026 roster amid a difficult cap situation by signing him to a new three-year contract, sources told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler on Tuesday.

articles.title: Source: WR Raymond leaves Lions to join Bears
articles.summary: Kalif Raymond has agreed to sign a one-year contract with the Bears, reuniting the wide receiver with Ben Johnson, a source told ESPN's Jeremy Fowler.

articles.title: Texans make Fairbairn NFL's highest-paid kicker
articles.summary: Houston's Ka'imi Fairbairn agreed to a two-year, $13 million extension, making him the highest-paid kicker in NFL history, his agency Athletes First announced Tuesday.

articles.title: Giants address CB need, agree to sign Newsome
articles.summary: The Giants addressed their need at cornerback, agreeing with Greg Newsome II on a one-year deal worth up to $10 million, his agents told ESPN.
